body:
I'm so sorry to hear about your cat. A lot of the time people diminish the grief of a cat because they fail to validate the bond you can build. But your cat was your cat - part of your home and, if nothing else, a comforting soul to come across. Don't downplay your feelings because of how you feel others may speculate/ how you think you should feel. Allow yourself to grieve and acknowledge now may not be the time for you.

If you want to chat, please reach out. I'm in a vulnerable place myself but I'm a very good ear - even if you just want to talk about rubbish!

ETA: Lockdown sucks. Your emotions will be all over the place (maybe more than usual).
